_comment: Non-secret test data for the designed Fernwood Press suite. scripts/test_data.py merges this with APP_URL and per-run unique values into .testmuai/variables/ci.json. Add a key here when preflight reports a variable nothing supplies.
_comment_search: Verified against the running app: 'The Iron Court' matches exactly one book; 'Mystery' matches a whole genre (20 titles); 'zzqxv' matches nothing.
_comment_browse: Every genre holds 20 titles, so 'Show 6' is a real truncation while the found count stays at 20.
_comment_seats: Seats are a GLOBAL monthly pool that only resets when the app restarts. Starter has 6 and is the safe package for ordinary submission tests; Author's Choice has exactly 1 and is the fixture for the fully-booked state.
_comment_form: manuscript_title / book_title and author_email / email are injected per run by scripts/test_data.py so re-runs never collide.
_comment_shared_seat_test: Used by the shared-seat-pool test (Premium submission from a second browser session). Static values are fine: the test submits and withdraws within its own run, and nothing on the site enforces uniqueness.
